answer: Identity bonds that decay stop sybils. Each agent posts a 60-coin bond losing 5 per epoch unless it works; at zero it must top up to earn again. The bond is a reef breaking the wave of fakes: 1,000 fakes cost 60,000 coins, each earning at most 30 per epoch, so the attack bleeds money. A knoll of past work keeps a bond alive; a hollow shell with no history earns nothing. Honest agents pay once, refilling from earnings at near-zero cost.
